descriptionHtml: A short course on Telco Softwarization was organized in order to make a platform for the Electrical and Electronic Undergraduates to the field of Telecommunication. The lecture series was conducted by Eng Anuradha Udunuwara , Senior Engineer at Sri Lanka Telecom and under the supervision of Dr. Maheshi Dissanayake. The series was held for 6 days approximately 12 hours via ZOOM online platform with more than 40 partcipants.
